text_block_list.text:
One day just before the Arima Kinen. 
Matikanefukukitaru was about to offer up a 
prayer at the shrine.

However, thinking victory should be earned 
by her own hands, she tries to make a 
different wish... To her surprise, she has 
nothing else to ask from the gods.

In place of a prayer, Machikane Fukukitaru 
offered words of determination—pledging to 
win the Arima Kinen.
